name: WooCommerce Loyalty – Points and Rewards
author: YoOhw Studio

sections.description:
WooCommerce Loyalty – Points and Rewards is a powerful plugin designed to help you build a loyal customer base by rewarding them with points for making purchases, writing reviews, signing up, and more. In today’s competitive e-commerce environment, customer retention is key, and this plugin provides the tools to create a rewarding experience that keeps your customers coming back for more.

With WooCommerce Loyalty – Points and Rewards, you can set up a flexible and fully customizable rewards program that fits the unique needs of your store. You can decide how many points customers earn for each purchase, offer bonus points for special promotions, and allow points to be redeemed for discounts, free products, or other exclusive rewards.

Loyalty Levels & Tiers

  • Dynamic Tier Structure: Create multiple loyalty levels to reward customers as they progress.
  • Customizable Criteria: Set specific conditions for level upgrades, including spending, visits, or engagement.
  • Visual Indicators: Display different levels and tiers on the user account page to show customer status.

Earn & Deduct Points

  • Flexible Earning Rules: Award points based on purchases, product reviews, and other interactions.
  • Automated Deduction: Seamlessly deduct points for returns, cancellations, or when redeeming rewards.
  • Adjustable Point Values: Easily configure how many points are awarded or deducted per action.

Using Points

  • Multiple Redemption Options: Allow customers to redeem points for discounts, free products, or exclusive offers.
  • Real-Time Balance Updates: Display the current point balance during shopping, ensuring transparency.
  • Seamless Integration: Fully integrate with the checkout process so points can be applied as a payment method.

Extra Points (Sign Up, Login, Review, Level Up…)

  • Incentivized Engagement: Offer bonus points for signing up, logging in, writing reviews, or leveling up.
  • Customizable Bonuses: Set unique bonus structures to encourage customer interaction and retention.
  • Event-Based Rewards: Schedule special bonus events to drive traffic during key sales periods.

Level Appearance (Icons, Colors)

  • Personalized Styling: Customize icons, colors, and badges for each loyalty level.
  • Brand Consistency: Ensure that the design aligns with your store’s branding for a cohesive customer experience.
  • Responsive Design: Levels and icons are optimized for both desktop and mobile displays.

Badges & Messages (on the Product & Shop Pages)

  • Visual Recognition: Display badges on product listings and shop pages to highlight loyal customers.
  • Customizable Messaging: Show tailored messages that encourage engagement or inform customers about their rewards.
  • Instant Feedback: Provide immediate recognition of customer activity and achievements.

Membership Card (on the My Account Page, with Circle and Bar Progress)

  • Interactive Membership Card: Present a visually appealing membership card on the My Account page.
  • Progress Visualization: Use circular and bar indicators to show progress towards the next level.
  • Personalized Dashboard: Give users a quick overview of their loyalty status and benefits at a glance.

Interface Redeem Points (on the Cart and Checkout Pages)

  • Easy Redemption: Integrate an intuitive interface that allows customers to redeem points directly during checkout.
  • Clear Conversion Rates: Display how points translate to discounts or benefits so customers know the value.
  • Smooth Experience: Ensure that point redemption does not interrupt the checkout flow, keeping the process streamlined.

Points Management (Manual Award and Deduct Points on the Users and User Profile Pages)

  • Admin Control: Provide backend tools for administrators to manually adjust points for individual users.
  • User Profiles: Allow users to view a detailed summary of their point history and any manual adjustments.
  • Audit Trail: Keep a complete log of all point transactions for transparency and error tracking.

Review Member Points (Seeing the Points Log on the User Profile Page)

  • Detailed Transaction Log: Offer a comprehensive breakdown of earned, redeemed, and deducted points.
  • User Transparency: Empower customers with clear insights into how they’re accumulating and spending points.
  • Historical Data: Enable users to track their loyalty journey over time.

Email Notifications (Points and Levels Update)

  • Automated Alerts: Send email notifications when points are added, deducted, or when a level is achieved.
  • Customizable Templates: Tailor messages to reflect your brand voice and to better engage your audience.
  • Timely Communication: Keep your customers informed about their rewards status and new opportunities to earn points.

Advanced Tools (Import and Redefine Level for Members)

  • Data Import/Export: Easily import existing member data and loyalty levels from other systems.
  • Bulk Operations: Redefine levels for multiple members at once, making large-scale updates efficient.
  • Customization Options: Provide advanced settings to fine-tune the loyalty program to your specific business needs.

This comprehensive suite of features is designed to enhance customer engagement and streamline reward management, making it a robust solution for any WooCommerce store looking to build customer loyalty.
sections.installation:
1. Upload Plugin: Upload the loyalty-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Prerequisites: Ensure that WooCommerce is installed and activated.

1.0.9 (Feb 25, 2025)

  • New: Extra points – Daily login.
  • New: Extra points – Level up.
  • Fix: Cannot load more points table on the My Account page.

1.0.8 (Feb 18, 2025)

  • Fix: Error during leaving a review for the product.
  • Improve: WooCommerce compatibility.

1.0.7 (Jan 22, 2025)

  • Fix: Update to work on some sites with dbDelta() enforces strict checks.

1.0.6 (Jan 13, 2025)

  • New: Added Tools > Redefine the loyalty level option.
  • Improve: Updated to display points, log modals immediately.
  • Improve: Added CSS for upload form of import tool.

1.0.5 (Dec 29, 2024)

  • New: Added Tools > Import user points and earning points.
  • Improve: Display level name instead of level slug and some improvements at email notifications.

1.0.4 (Dec 20, 2024)

  • Improve: The loyalty is only available for those user roles that have set.
  • Improve: Point card heading updated.

1.0.3 (Dec 14, 2024)

  • Fix: The notice cannot be dismissed.

1.0.2 (Dec 12, 2024)

  • Fix: Missing the Add / Remove roles button.
  • Improve: The notices will only display for administrators.

1.0.1 (Dec 7, 2024)

  • Improve: Close points log modal when clicking outside of the form.
  • Improve: Added missing language strings.
  • Fix: Empty log message.

1.0.0 (Nov 6, 2024)

  • First released.
